title: An ordinary model for terminal scalar realization
statement: For an essentially small site C in Type(u+1) with morphisms in Type u, topology J with monoidal abelian-sheaf local equivalences, a commutative internal sheaf ring O, and a terminal object U, use the fixed section ring A, realization F and ordinary sections E of [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model]. There is an additive ordinary functor L: Mod_A → Mod_O(Sh(J,Ab)), preserving flat objects and quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes, with a strong braided structure, an ordinary adjunction L ⊣ E, and a natural isomorphism from its K-flat total left derived functor to the fixed F. No exactness or tensor assumption on E is required.

proof.text: Define L by sheafifying V ↦ O(V) tensor_A M, using the terminal map V → U for scalars, then applying the fixed inverse section-module equivalence. Tensor and sheafification adjunctions identify maps L(M) → N naturally with A-linear maps M → N(U); the maps send m to 1 tensor m and extend by the O action. This gives additivity and L ⊣ sections.

The balanced map (a tensor x) tensor (b tensor y) ↦ ab tensor (x tensor y), inverse inserting 1, gives strong tensor and unit comparisons. Associativity, both unitors and symmetry agree on generators, hence after sheafification. The internal-section tensor comparison transports these to the internal model. For flat M, tensoring with L(M) is sheafification of tensoring sections with M and is exact. An acyclic K-flat A-complex stays acyclic after tensoring with every O(V), proving preservation of K-flat quasi-isomorphisms.

Choose a flat-term K-flat A-resolution. Constant realization preserves its flatness and K-flatness. The fixed universal extension counit therefore computes F on this resolution and identifies it with the localized L-complex. Both total left derivatives are universal; their counits give a unique natural isomorphism. Exact section reconstruction commutes with localization, including its different localization sizes.

theorem realization_underived_model
    {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) [(J.W (A := Ab.{u + 1})).IsMonoidal]
    (O : Sheaf J Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj O] [IsCommMonObj O]
    (U : C) (hU : IsTerminal U)
    : ∃ (L : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A J O U) ⥤ Mod (Sheaf J Ab.{u + 1}) O)
      (hadd : L.Additive),
      letI := hadd
      ∃ (hflat : L.PreservesKFlatQuasiIso) (hpres : L.PreservesFlat)
        (hbraid : L.Braided),
        letI := hflat
        Nonempty (L ⊣ sections J O U) ∧
          Nonempty (L.leftDerivedFunctor ≅ F J O U hU)
